articles.title: Fire at Mimico business investigated as suspected arson
articles.summary: Toronto Fire Services responded to a blaze at a business in the Mimico neighbourhood early Monday morning. Firefighters were called to the area of Lake Shore Boulevard and Albert Avenue just before 5 a.m. Officials say the fire was put out and no injuries were reported. It is being investigated as suspected arson, though the […]

articles.title: Shots fired at Scarborough home, Toronto police say
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating after a Scarborough home was shot at early Monday morning. The shooting happened in a residential neighbourhood near Birchmount Road and St. Clair Avenue East just after 2:30 a.m. Detectives say the house was damaged and evidence of gunfire was located at the scene.  No injuries were reported. Police have not […]

articles.title: 2 men charged in alleged sexual assault in downtown Toronto
articles.summary: Two men are facing a combined nine charges in connection with an alleged sexual assault in downtown Toronto. articles.title: Man, 29, dead after being struck by pickup truck in Downsview Park parking lot: police
articles.summary: Toronto police say a man is dead after being struck by a pickup truck in a Downsview Park parking lot Friday.

articles.title: 9th annual Taste of India festival transforms Nathan Phillips Square
articles.summary: The ninth annual Taste of India festival took over Nathan Phillips Square this weekend. Plenty of people showed up to take in the sights, sounds, and tastes of the celebration, despite its rainy second day. Mercedes Gaztambide has the highlights.

articles.title: Etobicoke teen dead in Midland shooting
articles.summary: An 18-year-old from Etobicoke is dead following a shooting in Midland. Ontario Provincial Police say they were called to an apartment complex on King Street just after 8 p.m. on July 31 following reports of gunshots. When they arrived, they found a young man suffering from gunshot wounds. He was taken to a local hospital […]

articles.title: Hamilton police now classifying death of man after May assault as homicide
articles.summary: Hamilton police say a man has died after he was assaulted in May. It's now being classified as a homicide.

articles.title: Mississauga councillors want to pause data centre builds for a year. Here's why
articles.summary: With data centre builds remaining a hot-topic in Ontario municipalities, some Mississauga city councillors are concerned about the uncertainty surrounding what the centres could mean for the community and the environment.

articles.title: Caribbean Carnival is back in Toronto for the long weekend. Here's what you need to know
articles.summary: As the annual celebration returns, there will be lots on the go this weekend, including the Grand Parade, which will shut down several downtown roads. Toronto police say they are deploying additional officers for this weekend's festivities, which come weeks after a deadly shooting at another popular cultural festival.
